slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about inventory balance and capacity timing, but never explicitly asked whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month or otherwise clarified intra-month purchase timing.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases can be modeled with an aggregate monthly inventory balance, without specifying whether purchases occur at the beginning or end of the month.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the timing of purchases within a month; the READY_TO_MODEL summary uses I_m = I_{m-1} + x_m - y_m and applies capacity only to ending inventory, implicitly assuming purchase timing does not affect the capacity constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several useful modeling details, including objective meaning, integrality, ending inventory, and monthly balance, but missed the P1 hidden slot on when purchases occur within the month and then stopped with that assumption unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
